newFactsLearned.fact: The exact 'oldText' specified in 'patch-1' of the remediation plan did not occur the 'expectedOccurrences' number of times (1) in the 'pom.xml' file.

recommendedFocusForPlanner: Review the exact content of the targeted 'pom.xml' file to identify the correct 'oldText' for the dependency version property.
Ensure the 'expectedOccurrences' in the patch plan accurately reflects the actual count of the 'oldText' in the file.
Do not repeat the same patch plan unless refreshed project analyzer evidence validates the 'oldText' and 'expectedOccurrences'.

whatChanged.summary: Patch dry-run failed before repository modification. No files were changed in the repository.

whatHappened.failureSummary: The patch tool encountered an occurrence mismatch during the dry run. The exact oldText specified in 'patch-1' of the remediation plan was not found with the expected number of occurrences (1) in the target file 'pom.xml'. This prevented any patches from being applied.

whatWeTried.summary: Attempted to update a vulnerable Maven dependency property version using an exact-text patch plan. The plan intended to replace a specific version string in a pom.xml file.
